findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "hub" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_url, scan_text, scan_url, scan_tools, check_email, screen_address, screen_batch, detect_stack, check_x402_endpoint, scan_for_leaks, perp_funding_scan, ta_risk, ta_backtest, smart_money_scan, hyperliquid_wallet, check_perp_order · Private data: check_agent, read_url, scan_text, scan_url, check_signature, check_token, check_solana_token, scan_for_leaks, smart_money_bias, hyperliquid_wallet · Public sink: check_email, detect_stack, check_x402_endpoint, scan_for_leaks, perp_funding_scan, ta_risk, ta_backtest, smart_money_scan, hyperliquid_wallet, check_perp_order · Destructive: screen_address.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_url, scan_text, scan_url, scan_tools, check_email, screen_address, screen_batch, detect_stack, check_x402_endpoint, scan_for_leaks, perp_funding_scan, ta_risk, ta_backtest, smart_money_scan, hyperliquid_wallet, check_perp_order · Private data: check_agent, read_url, scan_text, scan_url, check_signature, check_token, check_solana_token, scan_for_leaks, smart_money_bias, hyperliquid_wallet · Public sink: check_email, detect_stack, check_x402_endpoint, scan_for_leaks, perp_funding_scan, ta_risk, ta_backtest, smart_money_scan, hyperliquid_wallet, check_perp_order · Destructive: screen_address

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
